ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into the child care fraud scandal in Minnesota and its implications for the state's politics and policies.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would focus on the handling of fraud cases by Governor Tim Walz and the impact on his reelection bid.
questions: What was the extent of the child care fraud in Minnesota?
How did Governor Tim Walz handle the fraud investigations?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves a significant scandal that led to the governor dropping his reelection bid. It requires a deep dive into the facts and figures of the case.
